items.title: XOM Keeps Climbing. Should You Climb On?
items.summary: A large energy stock is running hot on real operational strength, forcing investors to decide if the ticket price for this momentum is already too high.

items.title: Two Low-Profile AI Data-Center Innovators That Investors Should Watch
items.summary: Never heard of Crusoe or Joulent? Tech and oil giants rely on hordes of small private firms for massive AI buildout.

items.title: Will Chevron’s (CVX) Expanded Venezuelan Oil Ventures Redefine Its Long-Term Cash Flow Narrative?
items.summary: Earlier this month, Chevron announced updated agreements with Venezuela covering its joint ventures, including enhanced fiscal, commercial and legal terms, additional Orinoco Belt acreage, and plans to invest over US$7.00 billion in the next five years to support higher production. A key feature is the Petroindependencia joint venture securing rights to develop the adjacent Carabobo 1 and Carabobo-2-South-A areas, expanding Chevron’s extra-heavy oil footprint alongside prior acreage gains...

items.title: Only 11 of 237 Active Dividend Funds Beat SCHD’s Index
items.summary: A 15-year scorecard just revealed how badly active dividend fund managers fared against a passive benchmark, and the results raise a pointed question about whether the most popular dividend ETF belongs in your portfolio right now.

items.title: Chevron Doesn’t Need Oil to Hit New Highs. Here’s What Could Drive the Stock Instead
items.summary: Chevron just posted its strongest downstream quarter in years while quietly signing a power deal with Microsoft that management calls a repeatable model independent of oil prices. The question is whether Wall Street has already priced in the transformation or whether the bigger move is still ahead.

items.title: Billionaire Harold Hamm Makes Deal to Explore for Venezuela Oil
items.summary: Billionaire shale pioneer Harold Hamm’s Continental Resources Inc. reached a deal for an oil field in Venezuela as the Trump administration pushes US companies to revive the nation’s oil sector.

items.title: Chevron Falls 2.6% as Contracts Supply One-Fifth of Its LNG Portfolio
items.summary: Purchased Gulf Coast supply adds flexibility while Chevron weighs capital-intensive expansion across several regions.

items.title: Warren Buffett Hates Bonds—and Berkshire’s Portfolio Is Loving Him Right Now
items.summary: The legacy investor, who now is chairman of Berkshire after spending decades as its CEO, has believed for a long time that stocks almost certainly outperform bonds. He turned out to be right.
